biology.subject: Biology
biology.def: Biology is the study of living organisms and their interactions with each other and the environment. It covers structures, functions, growth, evolution, and the processes that sustain life.
biology.description:
This roadmap guides you from the fundamental building blocks of life to complex biological systems and real-world applications. You will begin with cell biology and basic biochemical concepts, which form the foundation of all living systems.

As you progress, you will explore genetics, evolution, and the diversity of life, followed by detailed studies of human body systems and their functions. You will also learn how organisms interact with their environment through ecology.

At advanced levels, you will study molecular biology, biotechnology, and modern biological applications, helping you connect theory with real-world issues such as health, environment, and technology.

roadmap.title: Foundations of Biology
topics: Water and biomolecules (carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids)

roadmap.title: Cell Biology
topics: Cell membrane and transport (diffusion, osmosis, active transport)

math.subject: Mathematics
math.description: This roadmap takes you from basic arithmetic to advanced mathematics including algebra, calculus, and beyond. You will build strong problem-solving and logical thinking skills essential for science and technology.
math.def: Mathematics is the study of numbers, structures, patterns, and relationships. It provides the foundation for science, engineering, and technology, and develops logical reasoning and problem-solving skills.

roadmap.title: Calculus I (Differential Calculus)
topics: Applications of derivatives (tangent, optimization, rates of change, graph sketching)

mandarin.subject: Mandarin Chinese
mandarin.def: Mandarin Chinese is the most widely spoken language in the world, known for its tonal pronunciation system and character-based writing. It is essential for communication, culture, and global opportunities, especially in business, technology, and international relations.
mandarin.description:
This roadmap guides you from the fundamentals of Mandarin pronunciation and basic communication to advanced fluency and cultural understanding. You will start with Pinyin and tones, which are essential for accurate pronunciation, then build core grammar and vocabulary for daily communication.

As you progress, you will develop listening and speaking skills alongside reading and writing Chinese characters. Intermediate grammar structures and sentence patterns will allow you to express more complex ideas naturally.

At advanced levels, you will expand your vocabulary, learn idiomatic expressions (成语), and improve your ability to read, write, and communicate fluently in real-world contexts. The final stage focuses on immersion, cultural understanding, and preparation for proficiency exams such as HSK.

roadmap.title: Core Grammar (Beginner)
topics: Basic word order (Subject + Time + Place + Verb + Object)
Measure words (个, 本, 张, etc.)
Using 有 (to have) and 是 (to be)
Basic question words (谁, 什么, 哪里, 为什么)

roadmap.title: Essential Vocabulary Building
topics: Common verbs (吃, 去, 做, 看, 学)
Basic connectors (和, 但是, 因为, 所以)

roadmap.title: Listening & Speaking Skills
topics: Using apps or voice recording for feedback

japanese.subject: Japanese
japanese.def: Japanese is an East Asian language known for its unique writing systems (Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji) and context-based grammar. It is widely used in technology, entertainment, and culture, and is essential for communication and study in Japan.
japanese.description:
This roadmap guides you from the fundamentals of Japanese writing systems and basic grammar to advanced fluency and real-world communication. You will begin by mastering Hiragana and Katakana, which are essential for reading and pronunciation, along with basic sentence structures used in everyday conversation.

As you progress, you will build core grammar and vocabulary aligned with JLPT levels, while gradually learning Kanji and improving reading comprehension. Listening and speaking skills are developed alongside structured grammar to help you communicate naturally.

At intermediate and advanced stages, you will learn more complex grammar patterns, nuanced expressions, and formal vs casual speech. The final stage focuses on immersion, including consuming native content, thinking in Japanese, and preparing for higher-level JLPT exams (N2–N1).

roadmap.title: Foundations (Writing Systems & Basics)
topics: Particles: は, が, を, に, で

roadmap.title: Core Grammar (Beginner - JLPT N5)
topics: Basic verb forms (ます, dictionary form)
Basic question forms (か, 何, 誰, どこ)

roadmap.title: Essential Vocabulary Building
topics: Common verbs (行く, 来る, 食べる, 見る, する)
Pronouns (私, あなた, 彼, 彼女)

roadmap.title: Intermediate Grammar (JLPT N4–N3)
topics: Giving and receiving (あげる, くれる, もらう)

roadmap.title: Immersion & Mastery
topics: Watching anime, dramas, or news without subtitles

indonesian.subject: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
indonesian.def: Bahasa Indonesia is the official language of Indonesia, used for communication, education, and formal contexts. It is known for its relatively simple grammar structure, but rich vocabulary, formal standards, and cultural nuances.
indonesian.description:
This roadmap guides you from basic communication in Bahasa Indonesia to advanced fluency and formal language mastery. You will begin with basic sentence structure, vocabulary, and everyday communication skills.

As you progress, you will learn proper grammar, word formation, and sentence patterns used in both spoken and written Indonesian. You will also develop reading and writing skills for formal and academic contexts.

At advanced levels, you will focus on effective communication, structured writing, and understanding nuances in formal, informal, and regional usage. The final stage emphasizes mastery through reading, writing, and real-world communication.

philosophy.subject: Philosophy
philosophy.def: Philosophy is the study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, truth, morality, and reasoning. It develops critical thinking, logical analysis, and the ability to understand complex ideas and perspectives.
philosophy.description:
This roadmap guides you from basic philosophical thinking to advanced reasoning and deep understanding of fundamental questions about life, knowledge, and reality. You will begin by learning how to think clearly, analyze arguments, and question assumptions.

As you progress, you will explore key branches of philosophy such as logic, ethics, metaphysics, and epistemology. You will also study major philosophical ideas and thinkers that have shaped human thought.

At advanced levels, you will develop your own reasoning, evaluate complex arguments, and apply philosophical thinking to real-world problems, helping you make better decisions and understand the world more deeply.

physics.subject: Physics
physics.def: Physics is the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental forces of nature. It explores how objects move, interact, and behave across space and time, forming the foundation of many technologies and scientific fields.

roadmap.title: Dynamics (Forces)
topics: Types of forces (gravity, friction, tension, normal)

english.subject: English
english.def: English is a global language used for communication, education, business, and technology. It is essential for accessing international knowledge and opportunities.
english.description:
This roadmap guides you from basic English communication to advanced fluency and academic proficiency. You will begin with foundational grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation, which are essential for everyday communication.

As you progress, you will develop listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills through structured practice and real-world usage. You will also learn how to express ideas clearly and understand different contexts.

At advanced levels, you will focus on academic writing, critical reading, and professional communication. The final stage emphasizes fluency, confidence, and preparation for international exams such as TOEFL or IELTS.

economics.subject: Economics
economics.def: Economics is the study of how individuals, businesses, and governments allocate limited resources to satisfy unlimited wants, focusing on production, distribution, and consumption. It is divided into microeconomics (individual and firm behavior) and macroeconomics (aggregate, national, or global economic systems).

roadmap.title: Basic Economic Concepts
topics: Factors of production (land, labor, capital, entrepreneurship)

roadmap.title: Supply and Demand
topics: Price elasticity of demand and supply

cybersecurity.subject: Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.def: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting systems, networks, and data from digital attacks, unauthorized access, and damage. It involves identifying vulnerabilities, defending against threats, and ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information.
cybersecurity.description:
This roadmap guides you from the fundamentals of cybersecurity to advanced security practices and real-world applications. You will begin by understanding how computers, networks, and the internet work, which forms the foundation for all cybersecurity concepts.

As you progress, you will learn about common threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques, as well as how to defend against them using security tools and best practices. You will also gain hands-on experience with operating systems like Linux and essential networking concepts.

At intermediate levels, you will explore ethical hacking, penetration testing, and system security. Finally, you can specialize in areas such as network security, web security, digital forensics, or security engineering, while continuing to develop practical skills and real-world experience.

chemistry.subject: Chemistry
chemistry.def: Chemistry is the study of matter, its properties, structure, composition, and the changes it undergoes. It connects physics and biology and is essential for understanding natural processes and modern technology.
chemistry.description:
This roadmap is designed to guide you from the fundamental concepts of chemistry to more advanced topics in a structured and intuitive way. You will begin by understanding the basic nature of matter, measurements, and atomic structure, which form the foundation of all chemical knowledge. From there, you will explore how elements are organized in the periodic table and how atoms interact through different types of chemical bonds.

As you progress, the focus shifts to chemical reactions and quantitative analysis through stoichiometry, helping you understand how substances transform and how to calculate those changes accurately. You will then study the behavior of matter in different states, including gases and solutions, followed by the role of energy in chemical processes through thermochemistry.

Advanced topics such as reaction rates (kinetics), equilibrium systems, and acid-base chemistry will deepen your understanding of dynamic chemical processes. Finally, you will explore electrochemistry, organic chemistry, and biochemistry, which connect chemistry to real-world applications such as energy systems, materials science, environmental issues, and biological processes.

By following this roadmap, you will build a strong conceptual foundation, improve problem-solving skills, and develop the ability to connect chemistry concepts across different scientific disciplines.

roadmap.title: Basic Concepts of Chemistry
topics: Matter and its states (solid, liquid, gas)

roadmap.title: Periodic Table
topics: Periodic trends (atomic radius, ionization energy, electronegativity)

roadmap.title: Chemical Bonding
topics: Intermolecular forces (dipole, hydrogen bonding, London dispersion)

roadmap.title: States of Matter and Gas Laws
Acids and Bases
topics: Strong vs weak acids and bases

programming.subject: Programming
programming.def: Programming is the process of designing, writing, and maintaining instructions that a computer can execute. It is a fundamental skill for building software, solving problems, and creating technology across various fields such as web development, data science, and artificial intelligence.
programming.description: This roadmap guides you from the fundamentals of programming to advanced software development and specialization paths. You will begin by understanding basic programming concepts such as variables, control flow, and functions, which form the foundation of all programming languages. As you progress, you will learn data structures and algorithms, which are essential for writing efficient and scalable code. You will also explore software development tools such as version control and debugging techniques. At intermediate levels, you will build real projects and learn how to structure applications properly. Finally, you can specialize in areas such as web development, game development, data science, or artificial intelligence, while continuing to improve problem-solving and system design skills. roadmap.title: Software Development Tools
topics: Using an IDE or code editor

uiux.subject: Design (UI/UX)
uiux.def: Design (UI/UX) is the process of creating user-friendly, visually appealing, and effective digital experiences. It focuses on how a product looks (UI) and how it works (UX) to ensure usability and satisfaction.
uiux.description:
This roadmap guides you from basic design principles to advanced user experience and interface design. You will begin by understanding visual design fundamentals such as layout, color, and typography, which form the foundation of all design work.

As you progress, you will learn user experience principles, including how users interact with digital products and how to design intuitive interfaces. You will also explore wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing.

At advanced levels, you will focus on creating professional designs, improving user flows, and building consistent design systems. The final stage emphasizes real-world application, including designing complete products and improving user engagement.

bussiness.subject: Business & Entrepreneurship
bussiness.def: Business and Entrepreneurship involve creating, managing, and growing ventures that provide value to customers while generating profit. It combines strategy, marketing, finance, and innovation to solve real-world problems.
bussiness.description:
This roadmap guides you from understanding the fundamentals of business to building and scaling your own ventures. You will begin by learning basic economic and business concepts, including how value is created and how markets work.

As you progress, you will explore idea validation, business models, and customer understanding. You will then learn essential skills such as marketing, sales, and financial management to turn ideas into real products or services.

At advanced levels, you will focus on scaling, leadership, and long-term strategy. The final stage emphasizes building sustainable businesses, adapting to market changes, and creating real-world impact.
